verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Templates plugin lets users insert pre-defined text snippets (including date/time variables) into notes, and the Daily notes plugin builds on templates for recurring date-based notes, directly matching the power-user's need for reusable templates with variables. missing for 10: no explicit doc citation of variable syntax (e.g. {{date}}, {{title}}) or independent hands-on confirmation of template variable usage.
